# Corynebacterium jeikeium

Preferred treatment:

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-vanco-new-start-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

Alternative for vancomycin intolerance:

[Daptomycin 4-6 mg/kg IV q24h R](psjizid-daptomycin-6-mg-kg-iv-q24h)
